# glpi_datacenter_room (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI data center room.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_datacenter_room" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_datacenter_room" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `cell_height` (Number) Height of a grid cell in the rack view. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `cell_width` (Number) Width of a grid cell in the rack view. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `columns` (Number) Number of grid columns in the room's rack view.
- `datacenter_id` (Number) ID of the data center that holds the room.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `rows` (Number) Number of grid rows in the room's rack view.
